description: This file defines the public APIs and data structures for MIPI-DBI drivers in Zephyr, including interface modes, configuration structures, and function prototypes for command and display operations.

methods.name: mipi_dbi_command_write
methods.description: Sends a command with optional data to the display controller.

methods.name: mipi_dbi_command_read
methods.description: Reads a response from the display controller for a given command.

methods.name: mipi_dbi_write_display
methods.description: Writes a framebuffer to the display.
